Iron Colossus is the first boss you will encounter in your journey

"The Iron Colossus was an ancient golem, Far more powerful than those of modern times. It was built by the Ancients Builders, its body adorned with streams of pure iron, and an allium flower had even grown on its head, a symbol of life within the metal. Forged to protect, it sustained heavy damage during The Armageddon War. In a Final desperate act, it was designated as the Iron Keeper, the guardian of iron, to ensure that no one would wield its power. Unfortunately, it failed, condemned to wander the depths, guarding the secrets it could not defend."
You can summon the Iron Colossus by using an item called the Iron Remote.
Defeating it rewards you with three special items and unlocks the ability to mine iron and use iron tools, armor, and weapons.
Utilize bows and arrows if you find them in chests
Use your dash ability to dodge attacks
Charges an attack that slows players and deals "very high damage" with explosive impact
